All done. Here's a summary of the work:

---

**Geo-tiered CTA mode toggle — implementation complete**

- **`io/www/src/fragment/transformers/settings.js`** — Added `ctaMode` to `SETTING_NAME_DEFINITIONS` with `valueType: 'text'`, `editor: 'enum'`, and `options: ['default', 'buy-only', 'trial-only']`; automatically picked up by `SETTING_NAME_BY_VALUE`
- **`web-components/src/constants.js`** — Added `CTA_MODE` enum (`DEFAULT`, `BUY_ONLY`, `TRIAL_ONLY`)
- **`web-components/src/hydrate.js`** — Exported `applyCTAMode(footer, ctaMode, learnMoreFallback)` that suppresses non-active CTAs via `data-plan-type` attribute, removes them from the DOM with `aria-hidden`/`tabindex=-1`, and injects a Learn More fallback link when no CTAs remain; updated `processCTAs` signature to accept `settings` and call `applyCTAMode`; updated `hydrate()` to pass `settings` through
- **`studio/src/settings/mas-settings.js`** — Added `enum` branch to `valueEditorType` getter (including override mode) and added `enum` case in `valueInputTemplate` rendering an `<sp-picker>` populated from `settingDefinition.options`
- **`web-components/test/hydrate.test.js`** — Added 6 unit tests covering: no-op for `default`/`undefined`, dual-CTA suppression for `buy-only`/`trial-only`, single-CTA Learn More injection, and warning when no fallback URL is provided
- **`io/www/test/fragment/settings.test.js`** — Added 3 tests: `ctaMode` present in definitions, returned in settings payload from transformer, and delivered as text value in `fragment.settings`

**6 files changed, 211 insertions(+), 3 deletions(−)** — all `node --check` syntax checks pass, all 61 web-component tests pass.
